scope: Design only; no application, money, provider configuration, Trello writes, release or deployment.
question_exact: Next: if the payment provider definitively cannot process an owed refund, may the chef arrange a verified alternative payout and record proof? I recommend yes—but never while an earlier refund is pending or its outcome is unknown.
readback: Same owed refund, chef verified alternative with proof only after definitive provider unavailability; unknown blocks all routes. Shared reservation and recovery protect against duplicate returns.
